objective: Definir un evaluador puro y backend-authoritative de elegibilidad de beneficios Cavas. Debe recibir contexto de uso y una politica ya resuelta por unidad/contrato, y devolver APLICA/NO_APLICA con motivos auditables. No consultar SQL dentro del evaluador, no hardcodear horarios/dias/limites, no mover reglas al frontend. Debe soportar PERSONAL y CORPORATIVA, lineas ALIMENTOS/BEBIDAS/AMBOS, usuario registrado, contexto de negocio, dias/ventanas horarias, hora limite estricta, limite opcional de personas, vigencia de politica y estado de activacion del beneficio.

actions.content:
from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BenefitEligibilityContext,
    BenefitEligibilityDecision,
    BenefitEligibilityPolicy,
    BenefitIneligibilityReason,
    evaluate_benefit_eligibility,
)


def _policy(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        product_type="CORPORATIVA",
        benefit_line="AMBOS",
        active=True,
        valid_from="2026-01-01",
        valid_to="2026-12-31",
        allowed_weekdays=(0,1,2,3,4),
        allowed_time_windows=(("14:00", "20:00"),),
        strict_cutoff_time="22:00",
        requires_registered_user=True,
        requires_business_context=True,
        max_people=None,
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return BenefitEligibilityPolicy(**data)


def _context(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        operation_date="2026-09-07",
        weekday=0,
        local_time="18:00",
        requested_line="BEBIDAS",
        registered_user=True,
        business_context=True,
        people_count=8,
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return BenefitEligibilityContext(**data)


def test_eligible_context_applies():
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(), _context())
    assert result.decision == BenefitEligibilityDecision.APLICA
    assert result.reasons == ()


def test_line_must_be_covered():
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(benefit_line="ALIMENTOS"), _context(requested_line="BEBIDAS"))
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.LINEA_NO_CUBIERTA in result.reasons


def test_corporate_requirements_are_policy_driven():
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(), _context(registered_user=False, business_context=False))
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.USUARIO_NO_REGISTRADO in result.reasons
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.CONTEXTO_NO_ELEGIBLE in result.reasons


def test_day_and_time_are_evaluated_by_policy():
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(), _context(weekday=6, local_time="21:00"))
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.DIA_NO_PERMITIDO in result.reasons
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.FUERA_DE_HORARIO in result.reasons


def test_strict_cutoff_is_independent_of_regular_window():
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(allowed_time_windows=(("14:00", "23:00"),)), _context(local_time="22:00"))
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.DESPUES_DE_HORA_LIMITE in result.reasons


def test_optional_people_limit():
    assert evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(max_people=None), _context(people_count=100)).decision == BenefitEligibilityDecision.APLICA
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(max_people=10), _context(people_count=11))
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.LIMITE_PERSONAS_EXCEDIDO in result.reasons


def test_cross_midnight_window_supported():
    policy = _policy(allowed_time_windows=(("20:00", "02:00"),), strict_cutoff_time=None)
    assert evaluate_benefit_eligibility(policy, _context(local_time="01:30")).decision == BenefitEligibilityDecision.APLICA


def test_frontend_cannot_invent_eligibility_from_missing_policy():
    result = evaluate_benefit_eligibility(_policy(active=False), _context())
    assert result.decision == BenefitEligibilityDecision.NO_APLICA
    assert BenefitIneligibilityReason.BENEFICIO_INACTIVO in result.reasons

constraints: NO SQL dentro del evaluador puro
NO horarios/dias/limites hardcodeados como politica universal
El contexto debe recibir fecha/hora local/operativa ya resuelta por servicios canonicos
La decision debe incluir motivos auditables
